name: Tashkent (Uzbekistan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the round emblem of Tashkent: a blue disc with a gold gateway arch, plane tree, mountains and grapes, ringed by the motto 'Kuch adolatdadir'.
history: The city emblem by Saidalim Sharipov and Javlon Umarbekov was adopted in 1997 and restyled in June 2019; the white flag bearing it has no separately published adoption date.

features.role: emblem of Tashkent with arch, plane tree, mountains and grapes
